framework.title: EU Artificial Intelligence Act runtime-evidence crosswalk
framework.framework_edition: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 consolidated 2026-07-27, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
framework.application_note: Under Article 113 as amended, the Regulation generally applies from 2 August 2026, subject to its specified exceptions and transition dates. Chapter III Sections 1–3, except Article 6(5), apply from 2 December 2027 for high-risk systems referred to in Article 6(2) and Annex III, and from 2 August 2028 for high-risk systems referred to in Article 6(1) and Annex I. This crosswalk does not determine role, system classification, applicability, or the date applicable to any deployment.

controls.title: Observed runtime risk-event evidence
controls.mapping_note: Operational crosswalk for recorded errors, denials, and policy signals; applicability and satisfaction of legal requirements are not assessed.

controls.title: Observed record-keeping and integrity coverage
controls.mapping_note: Operational crosswalk for trace-event coverage and local hash-link state; applicability and satisfaction of legal requirements are not assessed.

controls.title: Observed human-oversight evidence
controls.mapping_note: Operational crosswalk for recorded approval and policy-intervention telemetry; it does not assess oversight design or effectiveness.

controls.title: Observed robustness and error telemetry
controls.mapping_note: Operational crosswalk for correlated results, errors, repeated-failure signals, and integrity coverage; it does not test accuracy or cybersecurity controls.

controls.title: Observed provider log-retention evidence
controls.mapping_note: Operational crosswalk for the presence, time span, and integrity state of provider-controlled trace records; it does not assess provider status, the required retention period, or legal sufficiency.

controls.title: Observed deployer monitoring context
controls.mapping_note: Operational crosswalk for persisted identity, authorization, and runtime-monitoring evidence; deployer status and legal applicability are not assessed.
